text:
Vikram: Quick flag from intake: bench p95=90ms, prod canary p95=220ms for same quantized build. Seems like bench not exercising long-prefix and cold-cache paths.

Dana: We see this often. Two lightweight fixes: 1) add a trace-replay smoke (sample 5% of recent traces) and 2) capture warm vs cold p95 in bench output.

Rui: Agree. Also record `quant_type` and `kernel_profile` in the validator payload. Small JSON we can pass back: {"synth_p95":"90ms","replay_p95":"210ms","quant_type":"int8","kernel_profile":"fused-mha","warm_cold":"warm:85ms,cold:210ms"}. Validator rules: ratio <=1.25 AND absolute delta <=120ms or flag.

Vikram: Good. Operationally: quick-smoke on PRs; if flagged -> run expanded replay in staging and create canary with 5% traffic.

gke-bot: noted. Will label PRs `bench-replay` when quick-smoke flag triggers.

Dana: Action items: Dana add trace-replay flag to bench runner (due Tue). Rui proto validator schema (due Wed). Vikram update intake UI copy (due Fri).
